prototype_feel_reasons: Visible TEMP labels make the map read as unfinished scaffolding.
The blank top capsule has no visible content and feels like an unpopulated placeholder.
The composition leaves a very large empty region below the map panel on mobile.
Map-node labels have weak contrast and inconsistent placement, reducing the cohesion of the placeholder presentation.
The orange marker overlaps the blue node without a clearly integrated attachment or shadow treatment.
issues: 11-world-return/map panel — placeholder nodes and TEMP labels visibly advertise unfinished asset integration — replace them with final map artwork or use polished neutral skeletons without debug text.
11-world-return/top capsule — large framed region is completely empty — populate it with the intended title/status content or collapse the container until content exists.

11-world-return/mobile page — map content occupies only the upper portion of the viewport, leaving excessive blank space below — size the screen wrapper to the viewport or vertically balance the map panel.
11-world-return/node labels — pale TEMP text has low contrast and inconsistent alignment across nodes — center labels consistently and apply an accessible shared text style.
11-world-return/blue node marker — orange marker sits partly over the node with a harsh, isolated outline — anchor it with consistent inset, masking, border, and shadow rules.
